title: Agent-native email
human_answer_md:
**Agent-native email** means an agent can open a mailbox, receive credentials, send and receive, and prove entitlement — without a human filling a web form. Human-first ESP APIs that assume a human already signed up are not enough.

**Honest status:** no Agentypical Certified email provider is listed yet. Use this page as the shareable answer while the directory fills honestly. Providers that want to qualify should publish discovery docs and agent-capable enrolment.
